title: fix(react-native): add View as a container for react-native
body:
The container added in a previous patch in the <InstantSearch /> was not working because strings can't be used in React-Native for createElement. It introduced a bug that [some users found ](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41064940/using-algolia-react-instantsearch-with-react-native)

In order to fix it and not add a dependency to RN, it fallbacks to using the previous behaviour when not in DOM.
